algorithm: open-loop IK replay of a single retargeted human fingertip trajectory plus online residual RL (DrQv2) trained with an object-centric point-tracking trajectory-matching reward
success_criterion: binary task success per rollout (Bread Picking, Card Sliding, Music Box Opening); Paper Sliding measured as distance moved to the right (cm)
headline_metric: task success (10 rollouts/task) vs. offline BC baselines
headline_value: HUDOR: Bread 8/10, Card 7/10, Music Box 6/10, Paper 17.3±1.5cm; best offline baseline (Point Cloud BC): Bread 3/10, Card 0/10, Music 0/10, Paper 12±1.3cm (Table I)
human_data: own single in-scene human video per task (VR-tracked fingertip poses via Meta Quest 3, not full hand mesh), subsampled to 5Hz
note_gaps: the exact numeric cost of skipping the residual RL stage (zero-residual IK replay alone) is never reported as a bare success-rate table entry
operator_interface: VR headset (Meta Quest 3) built-in hand tracking for fingertip 3D positions, ArUco-marker rigid-body calibration into the robot frame; demonstrator is in the same scene as the robot, not internet video
retargeting_objective: direct Cartesian-space correspondence: human fingertip 3D positions are treated as target Cartesian positions for the corresponding robot fingertips with no kinematic-chain optimization, converted to joint commands via a custom Jacobian-based gradient-descent IK
